sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 29

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 29:1
items.html: At the time of the ascent of the Partzufim, when the HGT of Arich Anpin became its HBD, then the Tifferet is not sufficient to be its Daat, but rather the aspect of the screen in the thirteenth correction, which couples its Hochma and Bina, called the Mazal, as written above in Answer 28 at length; see there. (Page 302, Item 13; Mevo Shearim, Gate 3, Part 2, Chapter 1).
